summary: Court documents read on 2026-10-30. In Commonwealth of Massachusetts v. Oz, D. Mass. No. 1:26-cv-12962-RGS, the Memorandum and Order on Cross-Motions for Summary Judgment of 2026-10-29 (Document 147, 16 pages), the Order of Vacatur and Enjoinment (Document 148) and the Judgment (Document 149), read in RECAP copies of the filed documents: the CMS community engagement interim final rule's added condition that a medically frail individual's condition significantly impair the ability to comply was held contrary to law, vacated under 5 U.S.C. 706(2) and enjoined as to the plaintiff States, with a six-month bar on penalizing them for implementation errors or delays; the twelve-month lookback and the self-attestation limit were upheld; the case was dismissed. Court status for c00-10 and c14-05 moved from pending to vacated (in part). In Goe v. HHS, D.N.H. No. 1:26-cv-00803, the CourtListener docket (last updated 2026-10-30) shows a 2026-10-30 minute entry for the preliminary injunction hearing and no ruling; c00-07 and c14-08 stay pending with the date moved to 2026-10-30. The Make the Road New York v. Mullin docket copy (last updated 2026-08-31) shows the en banc petition briefed with no disposition, as c05-04 already states. Two independent reviewers drafted and checked every text change. No stage change.
